May 17, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
John W. Rogers decreased its stake in Nokia Corp. Adr (NOK) by 26.23% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ariel Investments Llc sold 8.61 million shares as the company’s stock rose 13.81% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by John W. Rogers held 24.21 million shares of the radio and television broadcasting and communications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $112.80 million, down from 32.81M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ariel Investments Llc who had been investing in Nokia Corp. Adr for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $34.98B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.32% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $6.24. About 8.48 million shares traded. Nokia Corporation (NYSE:NOK) has declined 0.37% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 11.92% the S&P500.
Financial Advisory Group decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 46.88% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Financial Advisory Group sold 13,691 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 15,516 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.63 million, down from 29,207 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Financial Advisory Group who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $924.93B market cap company. The stock increased 0.93% or $1.74 during the last trading session, reaching $188.18. About 17.26 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 earnings per share, up 31.14% or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76B for 21.48 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78% negative EPS growth.
Among 56 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 37 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 66% are positive.
